tier_should.rationale: Clear, practical synthesis on Type M/S errors and external validity with guidance and example. Valuable for applied RCT communities, but novelty relative to established literature seems limited; impact depends on rigor, empirical illustration quality, and any methodological advances.

tier_will.rationale: Likely to place in solid field or methods-oriented applied journal; absent clear theoretical innovation or new data, top outlets unlikely. Acceptance hinges on execution quality and distinctiveness relative to existing tutorials.
